item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30415

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation.
In Kharkov region, Russian troops inflicted losses on formations of three mechanised brigades, one unmanned systems brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Aleksandrovka, Tomakhovka, Fedorovka, Bugayevka, Rubezhnoye, Sonino, and Primorskoye (Kharkov region).
💥
In addition, in Sumy region,
strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades near Korenek, Gorki, Spasskoye, Putivl, Markovka, and Nikolskoye (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 140 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 16 motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
⏩
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Izyum, Chervony Oskol, Ivanovka, Studenok, Monachinovka, Smorodkovka (Kharkov region), and Rubtsy (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 210 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, eight motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Russian troops inflicted fire damage on formations of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, one assault brigade, one airmobile brigade, and two assault regiments of the AFU close to Kramatorsk, Slavyansk, Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, Vysokoivanovka, Krasnotorka, Starodubovka, and Kondratovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 175 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 36 motor vehicles, one field artillery gun, and one electronic warfare station.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's units inflicted damage on manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, two air assault brigades, one assault brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades have been hit near Krivorozhye, Golubovka, Yakovlevka, Andreyevka, Sergeyevka, Belozerskoye, Varvarovka, Shavrovo (Donetsk People's Republic), and Ukrainka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
Up to 340 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, five motor vehicles, one Grad MLRS and one electronic warfare station have been neutralised.
👉
See
Part 2
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30412

Strategic partnership between Russia and China has reached an unprecedented level — Andrei Belousov
🇷🇺
🇨🇳
Russian Defence Minister Andrei Belousov held talks with Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China General Zhang Shengmin as part of a working visit to the People's Republic of China.
'The strategic partnership between the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China has reached an unprecedented high level,' said Andrei Belousov.
❗️
The Russian Defence Minister noted that
the partnership between the two countries is based on personal contacts between Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping.
'I would like to take this opportunity to congratulate you on your election as a member of the Political Bureau of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China,' the Russian Defence Minister said.
▫️
In his turn, General Zhang Shengmin also noted that in recent years the President of the Russian Federation Vladimir Putin and the President of the Chinese People's Republic Xi Jinping have met many times.
'The heads of our states have outlined new strategic directions for the development of China-Russia relations.
And today's meeting is a practical step towards implementing the important agreements reached by the heads of our states,' he stressed.
🤝
The Vice Chairman of the Central Military Commission of the People's Republic of China expressed confidence in the further development of friendship and cooperation between the armed forces of China and Russia.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered a massive strike
item.description: ❗️ Last night, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation delivered a massive strike by high-precision ground- and air-based weapons and strike unmanned aerial vehicles against power generation facilities of Ukraine in Vinnitsy, Dnepropetrovsk and Kharkov regions that supply electricity to defence industry enterprises and AFU facilities, as well as port infrastructure facilities in Odessa region used for military purposes. 📍 In Vinnitsy region, the following target was hit: ▫️ Ladyzhinskaya thermal power plant , with a capacity of 1,800 MW. 📍 In Dnepropetrovsk region, the following targets were hit: ▫️ Krivorozhskaya thermal power plant , with a capacity of 2,800 MW; ▫️ Pridneprovskaya thermal power plant, with a capacity of 1,765 MW. 📍 In Kharkov region, the following targets were hit: ▫️ Kharkovskaya thermal power plant , with a capacity of 86 MW; ▫️ Zmievskaya electrical substation , with a capacity of 330 kV; ▫️ Losevo electrical substation , with a capacity of 330 kV. 📍 In Odessa region, the following targets were hit: ▫️ at the port of Kiliya – port infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU; ▫️ at the port of Yuzhny and in the Black Sea waters – two dry cargo ships delivering military equipment and dual-use cargo for the AFU. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
